sloka: एवम् उक्तो नरपतिः ब्राह्मणैः वेद पारगैः ।गवाम् शत सहस्राणि दश तेभ्यो ददौ नृपः ॥१-१४-५०॥
transliteration: evam ukto narapatiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ veda pāragaiḥ ।gavām śata sahasrāṇi daśa tebhyo dadau nṛpaḥ ॥1-14-50॥

translations.english: Then those highly pleased brahmins, having distributed that wealth with equity, again said to the king.
